summary: OpenAI launched three new training courses on OpenAI Academy—AI Foundations, Applied AI Foundations, and Agents and Workflows—to help organizations build AI skills, developed with partners including BCG, Accenture, and BBVA.

practices.reason: The course teaches a generic workflow-planning concept but describes no concrete technique with a stated gain that an engineering team could implement.
practices.quote: Applied AI Foundations teaches how to turn effective prompts into structured, repeatable workflows.
